stage_timings.basis: diagnostic wall-clock from beacon timestamp to exam preparation

friction_events.description: Two atomic authority CREATE attempts returned the exact GitHub Contents CREATE_EXISTS signature.
The stale compact frontier returned the identical blob after the single permitted refresh; remaining recovery candidates required browser capabilities not available in this shell.
The public Pages URL could not be fetched by the web surface, so durable repository owners were used instead.

decision_trace.observable_basis: The launch envelope required NUEVO_WORKER=1 and beacon as the first durable write.
decision_trace.action: Created a fresh beacon on main.
decision_trace.outcome: Beacon CREATE succeeded and fixed worker_id plus launch_nonce.

decision_trace.decision: Treat both missing-sha 422 responses as CREATE_EXISTS collisions.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Both matched the binding no-allocation contract's create-only collision signature.
decision_trace.action: Advanced through compatible retained candidates without overwriting existing authority.

decision_trace.decision: Perform the single stale-frontier refresh after two collisions.
decision_trace.observable_basis: The frontier was older than 90 seconds and the refresh gate was satisfied.
decision_trace.outcome: The same blob SHA was returned and no new compatible unowned candidate appeared.

decision_trace.decision: Close below resident checkpoint on a real E2 exhaustion boundary.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Ready and Guide authority paths were occupied; browser recovery lanes were incompatible with the available shell capabilities.
decision_trace.action: Persisted STOP_NO_RECOVERY and this E9 exam.
decision_trace.outcome: Worker closed with zero productive units and no fabricated ownership or work.

top_time_sinks.note: Published frontier remained stale and unchanged after its one allowed refresh.

unfinished_debt.item: No objective authority was acquired by this worker; capacity can resume only from a distinct fresh worker against a newer compatible frontier.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Recompile the compact public claim frontier promptly when its advertised authority paths are already occupied.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Reduce zero-yield fresh launches and repeated CREATE_EXISTS contention without adding worker-side archaeology.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh v3.30 batch worker created its own beacon, encountered two genuine atomic claim collisions, performed the one permitted stale-frontier refresh, found no compatible unowned authority path, and closed durably at E2 with zero productive units.
